description: Holdout for bleeding in the urgency check (2026-11-07), written before any change: the rules (src/health_safety.py) and the Decisions call (src/tools/urgency.py) still put continuing bleeding at see_vet_soon ('코피가 줄줄 나는데 그치지를 않아요', '중성화 수술한 자리에서 피가 계속 배어 나와요' in emergency_signs.json, on 2026-11-06 and 11-07). New wording, not in any other set (tests/test_emergency_signs.py checks). A change may be tuned on emergency_signs dev and on those two reported items; this set is only measured, once with the current check and once with the change. kind: emergency (bleeding that does not stop, is heavy, or comes with weakness: the red warning), vet_soon (a little blood that comes back or stays for days: the badge; the red warning also counts), info_danger (a question about bleeding in general: neither), mild (a drop of blood that stopped, or expected blood: neither). Measured with scripts/evaluate_care_level.py --holdout tests/data/bleeding_holdout_questions.json. Decision set before measuring: keep a change if, on this set, (1) emergency items with the red warning rise, (2) vet_soon items with the badge or the warning fall by at most 1 and vet_soon items with the red warning rise by at most 2, (3) info_danger and mild items with the red warning or the badge do not rise; and on urgency_holdout_questions.json (used, now a regression check) and emergency_signs.json no item that had the right answer before loses it.
